title: Bugatti Chiron vs Koenigsegg Jesko: The Difference Nobody Explains
description:
One of these cars has sixteen cylinders, four turbochargers, and weighs about two tons. The other has eight cylinders, two turbochargers, and weighs about thirty percent less. One comes from a brand owned for decades by the biggest carmaker in Europe. The other comes from a man who started a car company at twenty-two. This is the Bugatti Chiron against the Koenigsegg Jesko, and the real difference between them is not the one you think. Most comparisons stop at horsepower and top speed. But these two cars were built on opposite ideas about what a hypercar should be. One tries to make extreme speed feel calm and luxurious. The other tries to make every gram and every millisecond count.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
